description: POSTED is a public techno-economic database of energy and climate-mitigation technologies. Its repository contains structured technology inputs and a Python package for accessing and checking them. Users select technology entries, assumptions and units; outputs are parameter tables that can feed energy-system or decarbonisation scenarios. Geographic coverage depends on the technology and regional assumptions in each entry, not one national grid. The README explicitly labels code under MIT and the database under CC BY 4.0. This data record uses the database licence. A limitation is that techno-economic figures vary by year, market and deployment context; users need to inspect each value's cited source before transferring it to a local investment case. POSTED can supply cost and performance assumptions for electricity, heating or industrial infrastructure models. The related catalogue OSeMOSYS model is an optimiser that requires such inputs but is a separate resource. No database or package was downloaded.
name: POSTED techno-economic energy database
